description: ROOT CAUSE (diagnosed 2026-09-14, sample + telemetry; A/B on 1ec2701a7 vs 445f71dc6 identical, so pre-existing): construct_tuple_ownership (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs ~4295) asks, per tuple item, any_later_ownership_use (~3951), which walks every later step of every reachable entry; each predicate (values_overlap_inner, origin_source_path, construction_children) resolves values through value_definition (~3759), a linear find over every projection and step of the whole body, unmemoized. Three nested linear scans. Measurements (debug build): 100 guard-helper calls over int/atom operands 0.14s; over tuple operands 50s; WITHOUT any helper, 25 lines of x = {{1,2},{3,4}} 2.7s, 50 lines 19.8s (~N^3). ~90% of samples in value_definition/step_defined_values. Guards, distinct operand kinds and activation counts are incidental; cross_kind_operators tripped it because a third of its cases carry tuple literals. FIX: build a ValueId -> definition index once per LoweredBody and thread it through the ownership predicates (cubic -> quadratic); if the later-use walk still shows, add a use index in the same motion. Regression test: 50 nested tuple literals in one body lower well under the harness guard; cross_kind_operators stays whole. SEPARATE DEFECT measured alongside, not fixed here: prepare_function_call (jobs/semantic.rs ~1770-1785) subscribes the caller to ReturnType(callee activation), so each new callee activation re-runs analyze_activation for the caller in full (12/18/26 analyses for K=1/4/8 distinct pairs); this is the downstream-monolith shape and belongs with that work.
title: Tuple-ownership lowering is cubic in tuple constructions: value_definition is an unindexed whole-body search
